mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate level signals an easing monetary cycle that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.5% indicates accelerating inflation, triggering central bank rate hikes that compress equity multiples and cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline signal robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, concurrent GDPC1 growth and HOUST increases signal sustained consumer demand, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion instances when GDPC1 and HOUST both rise.

mechanism_narrative: A low industrial production level indicates weakening economic activity, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS increases indicate aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity multiples and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary easing cycles, a federal funds rate decline reduces the cost of capital, increasing equity present value and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of monetary easing cycle instances when FEDFUNDS declines.
